description: Use when producing equity research, tracking brand share in AI sector coverage, or benchmarking a company AI visibility against sector peers. Example: Financials sector — JPMorgan leads at 34% citation share, Goldman 22%, BlackRock 18% — narrative focused on digital transformation and cost efficiency. Source: Stratalize AI citation composite. $0.10 USDC per call.
